name: Christian Tappan
bio: Christian Tappan Sorzano (Mexico City, February 19, 1972) is a Colombian-Mexican actor known for his work in Mexican and Colombian telenovelas. He began his career in television and later achieved success in film and series, earning numerous awards and honors, including the India Catalina Awards and the Platino Awards, as well as several nominations, including Best Actor at the International Emmy Awards.
